integrity.degree_formula_basis: Theorem 2 of arXiv:math/0105151 gives the closed multiplicity product and its appendix identifies multiplicity with the projective degree of the skew-symmetric rank locus.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The earliest cited public source, arXiv:math/0105151, records version 1 on 2001-05-17.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The matrix-rank-stratification anchor arXiv:1507.06621 is in math.AG and lists primary MSC 14F10, 13D45, 14M12; the Pfaffian multiplicity paper supplies the degree formula as supporting literature.
integrity.proof_basis: The curvature identity follows by exact cancellation of adjacent Pfaffian degree products; strict one-transition behavior follows from the explicit two-step difference of the sign polynomial.

scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the standard projective rank loci of skew-symmetric matrices, not arbitrary skew-symmetric matrix Schubert varieties.
At the exact bulk critical fraction \(1/\sqrt{17}\), the limiting curvature ratio is one and no universal second-order sign is claimed.
An unindexed source could contain the same curvature consequence of the classical Pfaffian multiplicity product.
title: A one-transition curvature law for Pfaffian rank degrees
